reason: As a solo CA with just one trainee, the free pilot already covers our 2 seats and gives me the trainee laptop shield for nothing; I have no operational need to spend ₹12,990 a year on a 5-seat plan.
objection: I am a solo CA with one trainee—why should I ever upgrade beyond the free tier?
would_change_my_mind: If our client base grows beyond 5 active clients and real-world testing on the free pilot proves the Trainee Laptop Shield reliably stops my article clerk from saving client data on their personal laptop.
